author: Kushal
problem: text is a ship's cargo manifest as read from a file, with one 'item,quantity' entry per line. Return the total quantity of cargo.
bug_description: Splits on newlines and drops the last piece ([:-1]), which only works when the file ends with a newline; otherwise the last entry is lost.

comments.accurate: Sums the quantities of every entry in the manifest
comments.wrong_behavior: Sums the quantities of every newline-terminated entry in the manifest
comments.wrong_location: Line splitting verified; quantities written with spaces like ' 15' may not parse
